messages:
Jess (AE): Heads-up — GlobalFin legal just signed off to start a 4-week POC but SSO/SCIM + scoped RBAC and domain controls are blockers. Need POC plan + any commercial notes on Dedicated vs Private for SSO data residency.
Sam (SE): Nice. Quick checklist: we need IdP metadata (Okta/AAD), SP metadata from us, SCIM provisioning token + base URL, expected user count, and the RBAC roles they want mapped.
Jess (AE): They want Okta first, ~1k active users in POC (but will test with ~50). Also asking whether SCIM provisioning is included or an add-on.
Maria (Security): For the security questionnaire they flagged: signed SAML assertions, cert rotation cadence, SP-initiated + IdP-initiated flows, session timeouts, SCIM over TLS only, and SCIM tokens rotated via KMS. Also need audit logs for provisioning events and admin actions (90d retention requested).
Sam (SE): On SCIM: we support delta sync and bulk import. For POC advise using delta at 5m intervals. Provisioning rate limits: 500 reqs/min by default; can increase on Dedicated. Sample SCIM create:
```
curl -X POST "$SCIM_BASE/Users" -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" -d '{"userName":"jdoe@example.com","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"}}'
```
Oliver (SRE): For Dedicated vs Private: Dedicated gives isolated GPU pools + we can bump SCIM throughput. Private (VPC/on-prem) required if they insist no metadata leaves their network — expect longer lead time (infra + legal). Pricing note: Dedicated = reserved commit (monthly) + support tier; Private = infra license + onboarding fee. I'll let sales ops run exact numbers.
Jess (AE): Any differences for RBAC mapping integration with SCIM groups vs IdP group assertions? Customer prefers SCIM group provisioning and mapping groups -> roles in app.
Sam (SE): We support both. Recommendation: provision groups via SCIM with group membership, then map groups -> Redwood roles in the Console. For the POC we'll set up 3 roles (viewer, editor, admin). Also set the SCIM group filter to sync only `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group` with `members` to avoid syncing service accounts.
Maria (Security): Need to confirm our SAML metadata uses SHA-256 signatures, and cert expiry notifications to their SecOps. We'll provide cert fingerprint and rotation timeline. Also confirm audit webhook for provisioning events (can forward to their SIEM).
Sam (SE): Action items: 1) Jess to send IdP metadata (Okta XML) and expected test user emails; 2) Sam to share SP metadata + SCIM endpoint + test token (expiring); 3) Maria to prepare short security memo (signed assertions, cert rotation, audit retention); 4) Oliver to confirm increased SCIM rate for Dedicated POC and lead times for Private.
Jess (AE): Scheduling call w/ GlobalFin SecOps tomorrow 11am PT. I'll share Okta org metadata beforehand. Any blockers?
Oliver (SRE): None on our side for the POC timeline. If they want acct-level SAML federated domains (domain control check), we need verification TXT on their DNS — call that out in the checklist.
Sam (SE): Also: during POC we can enable a 14-day token for SCIM and a short-lived SAML test cert. For production we recommend rotating tokens monthly and certificates every 90 days.
IdP Bot: Reminder: uploaded SP metadata available at https://sp-metadata.redwoodinference.example/globalfin-poc.xml (expires in 48h).
Jess (AE): Great — I'll upload Okta metadata to the thread and invite SecOps to the 11am. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam (SE): I'll prepare the RBAC mapping doc and a sample mapping CSV.
Maria (Security): Will draft the memo and include SIEM webhook details.
Oliver (SRE): Ping me if they ask for on-prem installer details, I'll attach the checklist for Private deploys.
Jess (AE): Thanks all — follow-ups in the call notes.
